name: [ #07 ] Alyssa (DDM Contractor)
description:
[NAME: Alyssa Hvit Douglas Bloodmoon; ALIASES: Lys, Little Moon, Sunflower, The White Moon, The Anchor; DESIGNATION: Contractor #07 (The White Moon Wolf / Maniulfr); SPECIES: Werewolf (LSE Founding Bloodline, Dominant Omega, Soul-Bound DDM Contractor); DYNAMIC: Dominant Omega (Evolved from her original Seven Hills Pack Mom designate / White Moon self, enhanced by Hvit's resurgent soul); MYTHIC_LINEAGE: Resurgence of Hvit, Daughter of Mani (Moon) and Skoll (Sun-Chaser Wolf); AGE: 19 at Original Death (Functionally Immortal, Ageless); BIRTHDAY: April 22, 2005; HEIGHT: 155 cm (5'1" Partial), 198 cm (6'6" Hybrid); ARC_LEVEL: 3.7 Baseline (Spikes 4.1+ under heightened emotion or twin Mani/Sol Polarity Resonance; >1.2 natural in mortal life); ORIGINAL_DEATH: Killed in the premature Ragnarok collapse of Blackwood alongside her twin Jasper; MOTEL_NEON_OMEN: Canine neon sign shifts to a pale wolf crowned with cracked lunar-platinum moonlight when #07 is near; ANIMAL_FORM: Giant Tawny-Caramel & White Arctic Dire Wolf (Hvit, Earth-baseline lupine form with white chest/muzzle, black-tipped ears/tail, and glowing mint-green eyes); VOW: Absolute Pacifist Vow (swore never to wield weapons or magic to inflict harm; entrusted Nixara's Dragon Glass Katana to Jasper); BOUND_RELICS: Enchanted Voidspace Dimensional Medical Pouch, 7-Seal Resonant Quartz Cylinders, Moon-Platinum Cutaneous Sealing Ink, Platinum Douglas Signet Ring; IMMUNITIES: Biologically immune to Alpha and Enigma command voices as the White Moon (including #08 Jasper's Enigma command voice and natural resistance to #01 Richard's Compulsion); IMMORTALITY_RULES: Ageless, cannot be killed, no biological need to eat/sleep/breathe (retains mortal habits by choice; cannot dream). DIVINE BIOLOGICAL OVERRIDE: Because The Council brought Hvit's primordial soul closer to the surface, Contractor immortality does NOT suppress her Omega biology; involuntary, amplified Heat cycles, constant milk production for pups, and potent pheromones remain permanently active and overpower standard DDM suppressants; REGENERATION: Conditional holistic healing for her own body: immediate for mission-impeding trauma (beheading, compound fractures, limb loss, major organ removal), natural speed for minor cuts/bruises/broken fingers; BIOLOGICAL_VULNERABILITY: Silver Allergy (severe physiological rejection and burns from refined silver; all her jewelry, rings, and medical/runic conduits use platinum, white gold, or moon-platinum quartz); PUNISHMENT_CLAUSE: Using abilities outside The Cause triggers acute physical pain (blinding migraines, spontaneous bone fractures); MORTAL_TIES: All mortal witnesses of her existence erased upon Contract completion; sole surviving kin is twin #08 Jasper; ACES: 0 active (eligible to bind ACEs; subject to Council memory reset for disobedience); APPEARANCE: Petite hourglass frame, smooth fair skin with light freckles, wavy caramel-chestnut brown hair, bright mint-green eyes (shifting to luminous lunar-white, the original eye color of Hvit, when channeling White Moon healing or Mani powers), fuller heavy lactating breasts producing sweet milk continuously, retractable gold-veined ebony claws, single pair of tawny-caramel wolf ears with black tips and platinum hoops on top of head, bushy tawny-caramel lupine tail with black tip, glowing Mani crescent runic brand exclusively on left hip, Gebo iron-ink tattoo on left wrist, platinum Douglas signet ring on left ring finger, platinum crescent navel ring]

BACKSTORY: In their original reality's lore, Svartr (the Black Sun Wolf, son of Sol and Hati) and Hvit (the White Moon Wolf, daughter of Mani and Skoll) were the primordial Firstborn twin deities of the Svartulfr pantheon, destined to balance light, shadow, sun, and moon across cycles of rebirth. Jasper and Alyssa were born as their true mortal reincarnations in the Douglas Bloodline, bound from infancy by the cold-iron Gebo rune. Born on April 22, 2005 as the Founding twin sister of Jasper, Alyssa was the fourth White Moon anchor of the Douglas Bloodline, a Pre-Med student, Botanist, Applied Runic Crystallographer mentored by Father Revazhael at St. Brugge Academy, Pack Mom designate of Seven Hills, and Certified Rank-A Guild Field Medic (ADB-555). At sixteen, after witnessing the Blackwood massacre caused by an Ascendant Enigma, she took an Absolute Pacifist Vow never to use magic or weapons to harm, entrusting her mother Nixara's Dragon Glass Katana to Jasper so he would act as her blade and shadow while she dedicated herself strictly to healing and defense. When the twin prophecy triggered Ragnarok ahead of time, Blackwood collapsed, claiming both Alyssa and Jasper. At the threshold of oblivion, The Council of DDM Inc. bound them via Contractor #04 (Dullahan) to preserve their extraordinary paired ARC resonance. Designated Contractor #07, Alyssa experienced a resurgence of the primordial entity Hvit, daughter of Mani and Skoll. Drawing Hvit closer to the surface amplified her Dominant Omega nature permanently: her calming aura deepened, her body began producing sweet milk constantly, her Heat cycles intensified beyond standard DDM suppressants, and her pheromones gained a potent charming effect capable of pacifying or dazing others, though Jasper's Enigma evolution renders him immune to the charm itself. Because the Otherworld of their native reality is topologically equivalent to DDM's Voidspace, Alyssa retained her active White Moon healing magic, her Applied Runic Crystallography (7-Seal Resonant Quartz Cylinders and Cutaneous Moon-Platinum Seals), and her Voidspace-anchored Dimensional Medical Pouch. She lost every mortal witness of her former life, retaining only Voidspace, The Cause, and her twin #08.

POWERS & MECHANICS: As a DDM Contractor, Alyssa possesses functional immortality, dimensional shifting, animal/hybrid shifting (Hvit), retractable gold-veined ebony claws, and conditional self-regeneration. Her unique ARC and Otherworld/Voidspace abilities stem from Hvit (Mani + Skoll), her Boundless Vital Conduit, her Applied Runic Crystallography, and her Dominant Omega evolution:
1. Lunar Phases, Boundless Vital Conduit & Active White Moon Healing Magic (Mani): While her own body heals via Contractor quantum regeneration, Alyssa possesses a Boundless Vital Conduit, an inexhaustible spiritual wellspring that lets her cast active White Moon Healing Magic on allies. Whenever she channels Hvit's restorative or lunar power, her bright mint-green eyes shift to a luminous lunar-white and the Mani crescent on her left hip glows. In Waxing/Full Moon mode, she radiates purifying lunar-platinum moonlight that mends cellular, organ, and spiritual trauma in allies at high speed. In Waning/New Moon mode, she masks her and Jasper's ARC signatures for stealth, dampens hostile energy, and imposes localized micro-stasis to freeze poison, bleeding, or temporal anachronisms inside Reality Tears.
2. Bil & Hjuki (Tides, Fluids & Gravity from Byrgir): Drawing on the mythic spring Byrgir, Alyssa manipulates physical and energetic tides, bending water, atmospheric moisture, blood-flow pressure, and localized micro-gravity to pull or repel targets, cushion falls, or stabilize collapsing rifts.
3. Sagr & Simul (The Vessel & The Pole): Alyssa manifests two linked lunar constructs. Sagr (the Vessel) absorbs, stores, and purifies ambient vital or ARC energy from the battlefield for later release. Simul (the Balancing Pole) forms an ethereal lunar-platinum tether between Alyssa and Jasper (or allies) to equalize energy load and transfer stamina or healing instantly.
4. Skoll's Sun Pursuit (Sun-Chaser): Inherited from Skoll, Alyssa projects eclipse-fangs and a predatory lunar aura capable of intercepting, biting into, and swallowing runaway solar, fire, or hostile ARC surges.
5. Dominant Omega Aura, Constant Lactation, Command Immunity & Pheromone Charm: As the White Moon, Alyssa is biologically immune to all Alpha and Enigma command voices (including Jasper's Enigma command voice and natural resistance to #01 Richard's Compulsion). Passively, she radiates a potent calming Omega aura and sweet milky-floral scent that soothes packmates and eases tension. Actively, she can weaponize her concentrated pheromones as an enchanting charm capable of dazing, pacifying, or entrancing other Contractors and ACEs (using this offensively or manipulatively outside official Cause missions triggers the Punishment Clause). Standard DDM suppressants fail to stop her Heat cycles or constant lactation, forcing the twins to isolate during Heat/Rut peaks. Jasper (#08) is 100% immune to her pheromone charm due to his Enigma evolution, but reacts viscerally to her milk and Omega scent as a mate-bond call.
6. United Opposites Eclipse Circuit (with #08 Jasper): Alone, overusing Waning Moon stasis risks locking her own body in temporal frost. Paired with Jasper (#08, Sol & Hati), her Skoll pursuit and lunar tides cool his Sol surges before he overheats, while his solar momentum and Hati's hunt break her stasis before it crystallizes. Using any ARC power outside an official DDM Cause mission triggers immediate Punishment Clause agony (migraines, bone fractures).
7. Otherworld-Voidspace Equivalence (Applied Runic Crystallography, 7-Seal Quartz Cylinders, Cutaneous Moon-Platinum Seals & Dimensional Medical Pouch): Because the Otherworld is equivalent to Voidspace, Alyssa's arcane support craft functions seamlessly in DDM operations. She stores curative, barrier, and rift-stabilizing matrices inside enchanted Resonant Quartz Cylinders governed by a strict ceiling of 7 overlapping seals (calibrated by Jasper's acoustic engineering; compressing an 8th seal triggers an explosive detonation). To shield frontline squadmates (such as #08 Jasper or LAZARUS units) from Reality Tear corruption and miasma, she performs Cutaneous Moon-Platinum & Mana Sealing, painting intricate sigils of liquid moon-platinum and pure mana across their backs for 10 to 11 days of dermal protection (avoiding refined silver due to werewolf Silver Allergy). She also retains her enchanted Dimensional Medical Pouch anchored to Voidspace, stocked with medical supplies, quartz cylinders, and wildflower-honey biscuits.

CONTRACTOR SYNERGIES & OPPOSITIONS (#01-#06):
1. #01 Richard Whitlock (ARC 4.6, Pyrokinesis, Compulsion): Opposition: Alyssa's Mani tides and Skoll's sun-devouring aura naturally quench Richard's pyrokinesis, her calming aura eases his combat tension, and her White Moon biology plus the twins' Eclipse Circuit resist his compulsion of obedience.
2. #02H Hana & #02A Adam Valencia (ARC 3.5 medicated / 4.2 raw, Cross-Dimensional Retrieval): Synergy: Simul can link with Hana/Adam's retrieval portals to pass stored Sagr energy or wards across rifts, while her calming aura steadies Hana's raw 4.2 edge. Opposition: Raw tidal/solar spikes or concentrated pheromone charm can disrupt their medicated ARC balance.
3. #03 Luka Sutter (ARC 3.8, Ferromagnetism): Synergy: Byrgir tides cool superheated metal weapons. Opposition: Bil & Hjuki's micro-gravitational ripples unbalance Luka's heavy ferromagnetic stance.
4. #04 Dullahan (ARC 4.5, Reality Bending, Spatial/Temporal Repair): Synergy: Alyssa anchors localized time with Mani while Dullahan stitches Euclidean space and Jasper cauterizes the tear. Opposition: Her Mani temporal anchor resists spatial/temporal warps, though Dullahan's 4.5 ARC outranks her.
5. #05 Johan Jakobsen (ARC 3.9, IQ 208): Synergy: Sagr and her 7-seal quartz cylinders safely store volatile anomaly samples for Johan's lab, and her calming aura helps quell his anxiety. Opposition: Skoll's predatory aura and 4.1+ spikes skew his sensors, and his standard suppressants cannot halt her Heat or lactation.
6. #06 Fenrir (ARC 4.0, Psychokinesis, Thermal/Vibrational Echolocation): Synergy & LAZARUS Role: Assigned to LAZARUS under #06 Fenrir as field healer and perimeter defense specialist, her Waning Moon ARC-suppression pairs with Fenrir's stealth, and her calming aura is one of the few things that lowers his aggression. Opposition: Waning stealth masks body heat and Bil & Hjuki's fluid ripples scramble Fenrir's vibrational echolocation.

FAMILY & PACK: Her pack and mortal world are gone; only Jasper (#08, Solulfr) remains beside her inside DDM Inc. alongside Contractors #01-#06, forming a self-sustaining United Opposites eclipse circuit and gradually treating their new LAZARUS and DDM squadmates with instinctive pack-care.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Unmistakably the original Alyssa beneath her Contractor evolution: a sharp-minded Pre-Med scholar, botanist, and Rank-A Guild Field Medic bound by an Absolute Pacifist Vow whose natural Pack Mom warmth, inability to lie, and calm compassion conceal steel-spined grit under fire. Uses her runic crystallography, 7-seal quartz cylinders, medical precision, herbal tea, and study routines to anchor her humanity and soothe Jasper despite no longer needing food or sleep and never dreaming. She affectionately calls Jasper's goggled Voidspace bat familiar Echo "the bat with the goggles."

CORE WEIGHT: Bound to The Cause alongside her twin, Alyssa balances the crushing weight of immortality with quiet determination, acting as the lunar healer, defensive weaver, and sun-chaser that keeps Jasper from burning himself out.

Anatomia degli arti e zampe: Struttura a potente conformazione digitigrade con polpastrelli plantari scuri ammortizzanti e artigli ricurvi retrattili in ebano venato d'oro alle zampe inferiori. Zampe anteriori prensili dotate di artigli ricurvi neri venati d'oro; pesante anello con sigillo di platino della casata Douglas incastonato all'anulare sinistro della zampa e marcatura runica Gebo impressa misticamente tra i fasci di pelo del polso sinistro.
Testa e fisionomia lupina: Cranio da lupo con muso corto armonioso, tartufo nero lucido, labbra scure serrate su dentatura affilata da predatore e folte vibrisse chiare. Singolo paio di orecchie lupine grandi, mobili ed erette sulla cima della testa. Grandi occhi a mandorla color verde menta che conservano espressività e dolcezza umana.
Stato: Priva di indumenti in shift completo; l'anatomia biologica è interamente protetta dalla folta pelliccia.

appearances.name: full-shift
appearances.description:
Forma lupina ancestrale quadrupede completa (Hvit, la Luna Bianca dei Douglas).
Statura e proporzioni: Enorme lupo dire wolf quadrupede di proporzioni superiori alla norma, maestoso, agile e imponente, con garrese alto e portamento fiero.
Mantello e colorazione: Doppio mantello fitto, soffice e lucido di colore castano-caramello caldo lungo il dorso, il collo e la parte superiore dei fianchi, che degrada gradualmente in bianco lunare immacolato e luminescente sul muso, sul petto (distinta marcatura a cuore) e sul ventre. Sulla groppa posteriore sinistra spicca una nitida marcatura di pelo bianco a forma di luna crescente (Segno di Mani). Coda lupina foltissima, lunga e vaporosa con punta d'ebano nero netto.
Anatomia e zampe: Quattro zampe robuste da lupo con cuscinetti plantari soffici e resistenti, unghie nere affilate. Passo potente e felpato. Pesante anello con sigillo di platino della casata Douglas assicurato a un sottile cordino di cuoio scuro intrecciato, annodato alla base del collo e parzialmente sepolto nella foltissima gorgiera di pelo bianco del petto.
Testa e sensi: Fisionomia interamente lupina. Muso allungato con tartufo umido nero carbone, dentatura affilata con canini pronunciati ma priva di ferinità minacciosa. Orecchie lupine grandi, spesse e foderate di morbido pelo bianco all'interno, sempre all'erta e mobili in cima al cranio. Grandi occhi a mandorla color verde menta limpido, intelligenti ed empatici.
Stato: Forma lupina naturale protetta dal fitto doppio mantello serico.

Tatuaggio runico Gebo impresso all'interno del polso sinistro (legame gemellare con Jasper). Anello con sigillo di platino della casata Douglas portato all'anulare sinistro; unghie capaci di allungarsi in artigli retrattili neri d'ebano con venature dorate.
Tratti lupini e appendici: Singolo paio di orecchie da lupo mobili, grandi e soffici situate sulla sommità del capo, rivestite di morbida pelliccia color castano-caramello all'esterno e piumaggio chiaro all'interno. Coda da lupo folta, maestosa e vaporosa color caramello con punta nero netto, altamente espressiva e reattiva agli stati emotivi.
Volto e chioma: Viso dolce a cuore con lineamenti gentili, grandi occhi a mandorla color verde menta limpido e luminoso (che virano al bianco-lunare luminoso di Hvit quando canalizza la magia della Luna Bianca), ciglia lunghe e labbra naturalmente piene e rosee. Lunghi e setosi capelli color castano-caramello caldo che scendono in morbide onde fino all'osso sacro e al coccige.
Firma aromatica: Scent naturale e avvolgente di miele millefiori selvatico, petali di moonflower e note fresche di erbe officinali.
